question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

This trailer **__gives a sneak peak of the magnum opus__** that has been created by the southern film industry.

options.text: gives a sneak peek of the magnum opus
give a sneak peak of the magnum opus
gives a sneak peak on the magnum opus

solution:
The correct answer is **"gives a sneak peek of the magnum opus."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "peak"** is incorrect in this sentence.
 
• It should be replaced with **"peek."**
 
• The noun **'sneak peek'** is the correct phrase to use to mean a brief preview or glimpse. (एक संक्षिप्त पूर्वावलोकन या झलक)
 
 
• **Example**: *She took a **sneak peek**__ at the birthday presents hidden in the closet.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *This trailer __**gives a sneak peek of the magnum opus**__ that has been created by the southern film industry.*
